entries.text: Tack: purchasing and sipping fresh lubrication oil: "Just... a top-up for the long telemetry run ahead."
entries.why: Fluid levels are dangerously low and precision requires smooth joints.

entries.text: plugged into the charging dock, battery sipping juice and dish twitching softly
entries.why: my battery is getting low and a quick nap will get my gears spinning properly again

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "Quick Power Nap"
